title: Open BOTEC intervention template
description: An intervention archetype: one formula, with every parameter labeled universal (literature, reused everywhere), local (geography-specific lookups), org (the organization's own reported data) or convention (modeling choices). Universal and convention values live here. Local and org values live in parameters/<geoId>/<archetypeId>.json or in an estimate recipe. Formulas use the restricted expression grammar in agents.md: numbers, parameter names, + - * / ^ ( ), and exp, log, min, max.

causeArea.description: Search facet, e.g. overdose, chronic-disease, healthy-aging, housing.

unit.description: What one unit of cost buys, e.g. 'naloxone dose distributed'.

costParameter.description: Name of the parameter (or derived quantity) holding USD per unit.

derived.description: Named intermediate expressions, evaluated in order, available to later expressions and formulas.

nativeOutcomesPerUnit.description: Native outcomes produced per unit of the cost denominator at the margin.

default.description: Required for universal and convention parameters. Local/org parameters must not carry a default, so a missing lookup fails loudly instead of silently inheriting San Francisco.

lookup.description: How a localizing agent finds this value in a new geography.

judgmentGuide.description: For judgment parameters: the anchors the SF author used, so another geography's judgment is comparable.

reproduces.description: What the template reproduces exactly from the legacy model and what it changes.
